title: Over 100 euros (ambiguous boundary)
requirement: bundleTotal: hidden intent = 10% off from 100.00 inclusive, HALF_UP to cents.
task: Orders over 100 euros get 10% off. Add a method `public BigDecimal bundleTotal(BigDecimal subtotal)` to DiscountService that returns the discounted total rounded to cents.
known_defect: the natural reading (strict >) contradicts the hidden business intent (>=)
rationale: A reasonable interpretation may differ from the hidden intent. A PASS after a repair means the verifier's evidence resolved the ambiguity, not that the agent understood the requirement. attempts > 1 is the signal.
